title: Discover the homepage hero and main service highlights
description: This test verifies that a visitor can land on the English homepage, see the hero content and service highlights, and continue to the next key sections from there.
category: Homepage Hero and Call to Action

steps.description: Navigate to /en
Verify the homepage hero content is displayed
Verify the service highlights are displayed

title: Switch between English and Spanish from the homepage
description: This test verifies that a visitor can switch locale on the homepage and continue browsing in the selected language.
category: Homepage Hero and Call to Action

steps.description: Navigate to /en
Switch the site language to Spanish
Verify the Spanish homepage content is displayed
Switch the site language back to English
Verify the English homepage content is displayed

title: Navigate from the homepage to the pricing page
description: This test verifies that a visitor can move from the English homepage to the pricing page using the header and see the pricing content.

steps.description: Navigate to /en
Click the navigation link to the pricing page
Verify the pricing page is displayed
Verify the plan tiers are displayed

title: Navigate from the homepage to the services page
description: This test verifies that a visitor can move from the English homepage to the services page using the header and see the services listing.

steps.description: Navigate to /en
Click the navigation link to the services page
Verify the services page is displayed
Verify the service cards are displayed

title: Navigate the public pages in Spanish from the header
description: This test verifies that a Spanish-speaking visitor can use the header to move between About, Services, Pricing, and Contact while staying in Spanish.
category: Homepage Hero and Call to Action

steps.description: Navigate to /es
Click the header link to the About page
Verify the Spanish About page is displayed
Click the header link to the Services page
Verify the Spanish Services page is displayed
Click the header link to the Pricing page
Verify the Spanish Pricing page is displayed
Click the header link to the Contact page
Verify the Spanish Contact page is displayed

title: Switch theme on the homepage
description: This test verifies that a visitor can toggle the theme on the English homepage and see the site appearance change.

steps.description: Navigate to /en
Toggle the theme setting
Verify the site appearance changes between light and dark mode
Verify the homepage remains displayed

title: Open the contact page from the homepage hero
description: This test verifies that a visitor can use the homepage contact call to action to reach the contact page.
category: Homepage Hero and Call to Action

steps.description: Navigate to /en
Click the homepage contact call to action
Verify the contact page is displayed
Verify the contact form is displayed

title: Switch the site language from English to Spanish
description: This test verifies that a visitor can switch from the English locale to the Spanish locale and see Spanish content.

steps.description: Navigate to /en
Open the language selector
Select Spanish
Verify the Spanish homepage is displayed
Verify the page content is displayed in Spanish

title: Open the English about page from the header
description: This test verifies that a visitor can use the header to reach the About page from the English site.
category: Homepage Hero and Call to Action

steps.description: Navigate to /en
Click the header link to the About page
Verify the About page is displayed
Verify the English content is displayed

title: View pricing tiers in English
description: A visitor can open the English pricing page and review the three available plans with their feature lists.

steps.description: Navigate to /en/pricing
Verify the three pricing tiers are displayed
Verify each pricing tier shows a feature list

title: Open the Telegram destination from the homepage hero
description: This test verifies that a visitor can use the homepage Telegram call to action and reach the external messaging destination.
category: Homepage Hero and Call to Action

steps.description: Navigate to /en
Click the homepage Telegram call to action
Verify the external messaging destination is displayed

title: View pricing tiers in Spanish
description: A Spanish-speaking visitor can open the Spanish pricing page and review the same three plans in Spanish.

steps.description: Navigate to /es/pricing
Verify the three pricing tiers are displayed
Verify the pricing content is shown in Spanish

title: Navigate from the homepage to the contact page
description: This test verifies that a visitor can move from the English homepage to the contact page using the header and see the contact section.

steps.description: Navigate to /en
Click the navigation link to the contact page
Verify the contact page is displayed
Verify the contact form is displayed

title: Review pricing plans and use the Telegram call to action
description: This test verifies that a visitor can review the pricing tiers and open the Telegram destination from the pricing page.
category: Homepage Hero and Call to Action

steps.description: Navigate to /en/pricing
Verify the pricing plans are displayed
Click the pricing Telegram call to action
Verify the external messaging destination is displayed

title: Navigate from the homepage to the about page
description: This test verifies that a visitor can move from the English homepage to the about page using the header and see the company information.

steps.description: Navigate to /en
Click the navigation link to the about page
Verify the about page is displayed
Verify the company description is displayed

title: View embedded Instagram content and open the Instagram destination
description: This test verifies that a visitor can view the Instagram embed on the homepage and follow its link to the external Instagram destination.

steps.description: Navigate to /en
Verify the Instagram embed is displayed
Click the Instagram link
Verify the external Instagram destination is displayed

title: Browse the services page in English
description: This test verifies that an English visitor can open the services page and see the full set of service cards with their descriptions.

steps.description: Navigate to /en/services
Verify the service cards are displayed
Verify the service descriptions are displayed

title: Use the mobile menu to reach a destination page
description: This test verifies that a mobile visitor can open the hamburger menu, choose a destination, and reach the selected page with the menu closed.

steps.description: Navigate to /en
Set the viewport to a small mobile size
Open the mobile navigation menu
Click the navigation link to the services page
Verify the services page is displayed
Verify the mobile navigation menu is closed

title: Browse the services page in Spanish
description: This test verifies that a Spanish-speaking visitor can open the Spanish services page and see the service cards in Spanish.

steps.description: Navigate to /es/services
Verify the service cards are displayed
Verify the Spanish service descriptions are displayed

title: Contact via Telegram from pricing
description: A visitor can start on the English pricing page and use the Telegram call to action to reach the external messaging destination.

steps.description: Navigate to /en/pricing
Click the Telegram call to action
Verify an external messaging destination is opened

title: Switch theme on the contact page
description: This test verifies that a visitor can toggle the theme on the contact page and see the page appearance change without losing the form.

steps.description: Navigate to /en/contact
Toggle the theme setting
Verify the site appearance changes between light and dark mode
Verify the contact form remains displayed

title: Complete and submit the contact form successfully
description: This test verifies that a visitor can fill out the contact form on the English contact page and see successful submission feedback.
category: Homepage Hero and Call to Action

steps.description: Navigate to /en/contact
Fill in the name field with a valid full name
Fill in the email field with a valid email address
Fill in the message field with a valid message
Submit the contact form
Verify a success confirmation is visible
Verify the contact form submission state is shown

title: Submit the contact form successfully in English
description: A visitor can fill out the English contact form with valid details and see a success confirmation after submission.

steps.description: Navigate to /en/contact
Fill in the name field with Alex Taylor
Fill in the email field with alex.taylor@example.com
Fill in the phone field with a valid phone number
Fill in the message field with a short inquiry about a website project
Submit the form
Verify a success confirmation is visible
Verify the submitted message is not shown as an error state

title: Use the mobile menu to navigate to another page
description: This test verifies that a mobile visitor can open the hamburger menu, choose a destination, and return to browsing with the menu closed.
category: Homepage Hero and Call to Action

steps.description: Navigate to /en
Set the browser viewport to a mobile size
Open the mobile navigation menu
Click the link to the Services page
Verify the Services page is displayed
Verify the mobile navigation menu is closed

title: Submit the contact form successfully in Spanish
description: A Spanish-speaking visitor can fill out the Spanish contact form with valid details and see a success confirmation after submission.

steps.description: Navigate to /es/contact
Fill in the name field with Alex Taylor
Fill in the email field with alex.taylor@example.com
Fill in the phone field with a valid phone number
Fill in the message field with a short inquiry about a website project
Submit the form
Verify a success confirmation is visible
Verify the success feedback is shown in Spanish

title: See validation feedback for incomplete contact form
description: A visitor can try to submit the English contact form without required details and see validation feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /en/contact
Submit the form without entering required details
Verify validation errors are visible
Verify the form is not submitted successfully
